goal: G006 — Unified host role UI and complete-set packaging foundations

highlights: canon: JCS-subset canonicalization (sorted keys, no whitespace, minimal escaping, UTF-8 literal), float rejection loud + named in error
manifest: sign/verify roundtrip, tamper-component, tamper-metadata, wrong-key, mixed-version rejection, protocol match/mismatch, component-name traversal/absolute rejection
verify: correct set, tampered file, missing component, planted extra file (top-level and nested) rejected, manifest self allow-listed, idempotent re-verify

swap: decision-table recovery states, fresh install, upgrade-keeps-prev, interrupted-mid-swap exact previous-set restore, interrupted-after-move no-op, idempotent recovery, version sanitization, prev-dir collision timestamp fallback
lib: pinned dev trust root hex (independently derived), parse_trust_root_hex roundtrip/malformed/wrong-length
update:: idle/staged/wrong-key/protocol-mismatch/tamper at the UI-status boundary; staged_dir/manifest_path layout pin; cache Idle-fast-path, Checking-then-settle, invalidate-recheck
g006_role_tests:: role_transitions_never_disturb_an_active_client_session (via shared apply_role_action seam), role_label exact strings

host:: role_transition_covers_every_pair, role_wants_host, health_state_label exact text, lifecycle event exact fragments, pairing_hint http/https + unspecified-bind substitution, host_role_boots_and_stops with injected &Settings
